decisions.decision: Next milestone is v1.7 DAW Plugin Port (not v2.0)
decisions.rationale: v1.7 is a continuation of the v1.x series shipping the same product surface in new wrappers; not a breaking redesign.

decisions.decision: All 4 plugin formats (VST3 + AU + LV2 + CLAP)
decisions.rationale: Anthony's call. Covers Reaper/Live/Studio One/Cubase (VST3), Logic (AU), Ardour/Linux-native (LV2), and Bitwig/Reaper-modern (CLAP). AU is macOS-only so 10 unique binaries total across 3 OSes.
Anthony's call. Beta testers skew Mac/Windows for DAW work; Linux-first is preserved but no longer exclusive.

decisions.decision: Plugin compatible with any host SR/BD; bit-faithful C core untouchable
decisions.rationale: Anthony was emphatic about this. SR/BD conversion is a real-time wrapper concern (float<->int16 in/out + SRC to/from 44.1k). Same architectural principle as the standalone WAV loader, just real-time. Verified by golden regression.

decisions.decision: Standalone (v1.6) continues to ship alongside plugin formats, not in place of them
decisions.rationale: Existing user base; standalone is its own valuable surface.

decisions.decision: Beta-tester preset return-loop OUT of scope for v1.7
decisions.rationale: Anthony explicitly confirmed. Whatever channel he already uses (Discord, email, GitHub issues with attachments) handles preset return; no in-app submission UI needed.

decisions.decision: Custom plugin UI redesign OUT of scope for v1.7
decisions.rationale: Reuse current standalone GUI in the plugin window. UI work is a separate later milestone candidate.

decisions.decision: Code signing / notarization can defer for beta
decisions.rationale: Beta testers can override Gatekeeper/SmartScreen warnings; revisit if install friction is reported.
